newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four killed, three injured in Russian air crash.
newsitem.headline: Four killed, three injured in Russian air crash.

text.p: Four people were killed on Tuesday and another three injured when a small AN-2 plane hit a high-voltage power line and crashed shortly after taking off from the central Russian town of Tula, the emergencies ministry said.
A spokeswoman said the plane, which belonged to a local airline and crashed 10 minutes into the flight, was heading for the southern city of Rostov.
